reference_sql:
WITH store_rev AS (  -- one row per store with 2025 sales
  SELECT st.store_code, st.country_code, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = s.store_code
  WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND s.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY st.store_code, st.country_code
)
SELECT store_code, country_code, revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code), 2) AS country_avg,
       revenue < 0.8 * AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code) AS below_80
FROM store_rev

  GROUP BY st.store_code, st.country_code
),
compared AS (  -- one row per store with 2025 sales
  SELECT store_code, country_code, revenue,
         AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code) AS avg_rev
  FROM store_rev
)
SELECT store_code, country_code, revenue, ROUND(avg_rev, 2) AS country_avg,
       CASE WHEN revenue < 0.8 * avg_rev THEN true ELSE false END AS below_80
FROM compared
